entities.label: Text
entities.summary: Written by Murasaki Shikibu in early 11th-century Japan, The Tale of Genji is widely considered the world's first novel. This 54-chapter narrative of court life, romantic intrigue, and psychological depth in Heian-period Japan established literary techniques — interior monologue, character development, narrative structure — that anticipate the modern novel by 800 years.
